C238_SPREAD.statement: Distinct coordinate averages spread a dipole over disjoint subcubes with exact squared norm 2^(-|S|-1) times its amplitude squared; averaging its own coordinate kills it.

C238_COMPONENT.statement: Conditionally on F_a, different components of the future deterministic coordinate word have independent (free set, centered flow) pairs; single-position availability is the initial component density.

C238_GENERAL_ENERGY.statement: For an arbitrary deterministic coordinate word, conditional energy equals the projected initial energy plus one weighted noise term for each coordinate's last occurrence.
